title: ma-imports category file (authoring shape v2)
description: One products/{category-slug}.json file: an array of the products in that category. v2 separates the concerns v1 fused into `name` (identifier, brand, model, display string, sort key) and models `sizes` as a list of independently sellable units. The build re-derives the v1 runtime shape from this, so dist/products/*.json is unchanged for the client — see tools/lib/runtime.js.

product.description: A single catalog entry. One entry may hold several units in different sizes.

id.description: The [DDMMYYHHmm] code, promoted from inside `name` to a field of its own. Unique across the catalog, enforced as a build error: the code exists to tell two same-brand products apart, so a collision defeats its purpose. Internal to the catalog today, but published as a shareable URL from Wave 7, after which it must never be reused.

brand.description: A slug declared in catalog/brands.json. `unbranded` is the sentinel for a product with no brand, including the six placeholder strings that were never brands.

model.description: The product line within the brand — 'Shox' for a Nike Shox. Also carries the original text of a placeholder brand string, so nothing is lost by mapping it to `unbranded`.

price.description: Current price in BRL. Rendered through formatCurrency, so a number rather than a formatted string.

oldPrice.description: Pre-discount price in BRL, struck through on the card. Omitted when there is no discount — v1 used 0 as a sentinel. Must exceed price, which JSON Schema cannot express and validate.js checks separately.

sizes.description: The units in this row, each independently sellable. Empty when the product has no meaningful size (a wallet, a cap) or when its size is a range rather than a list — see sizeNote.

sizeNote.description: Free text for anything that is not a list of sizes: a range-fit value such as '37 ao 44', or 'Consultar', 'Tamanho único', 'Pequena'. Rendered in place of a size.

soldOut.description: Marks a row sold out when it has no units to carry the flag — a cap, a wallet, a pair of socks that fits any foot. Only valid when `sizes` is empty; a row with units derives it from them, and validate.js rejects carrying both. Omitted when false.

description.description: Prose shown under the name. Omitted rather than empty: v1 had three states for 'no description', and v2 has one.

images.description: Repository-relative paths to the product's photos, in display order. Stored rather than computed, because four references disagreed with their product code before validation caught it.

items.description: A .jpeg under images/, named for the owning product's code and located per its category's declared shape. validate.js enforces both, which JSON Schema cannot express.

listedAt.description: When the product was listed, in UTC. The sort key, replacing the two duplicate regex parsers that derived it from `name` using local time — so the build host's timezone no longer affects tie ordering.

unit.description: One physical item in a size.

size.description: The size as the seller writes it. Deliberately unconstrained by an enum: several vocabularies are in use (P/M/G, waist numbers, shoe numbers, children's ages). See RD-2.

soldOut.description: Omitted when false. A row renders as sold out only when every unit in it is.
